name: kijiji-canada-rentals-scraper
title: Rental Listings Scraper — Canada + UK + US (Kijiji, RentFaster, OpenRent, Zumper) + Geo Data
description: Scrape rental listings from Kijiji + RentFaster.ca (Canada), OpenRent (UK), and Zumper (US) in one normalized schema — price, beds, baths, coordinates, currency — with cross-source dedup and nearest-amenity (subway/grocery/school) distances. Apartments, flats, houses, rooms.
